create_MLP_model: create an MLP model with specified input, output, hidden dimensions and dropout rate
run_MLP_forward: run a forward pass through the MLP model to normalize input and produce denormalized output
train_MLP_learn: train the MLP model by computing MSE loss on normalized input and output tensors
review_MLP_input_dim: review the MLP model to retrieve the input dimension from its running stats
review_MLP_output_dim: review the MLP model to retrieve the output dimension from its running stats
